description: List every place in the Homeric Atlas with its identification class, its confidence score and how many competing identifications it carries. Use this to browse the atlas; use `get_homeric_place` once you have a slug. Identification classes: accepted (an excavated site with consensus), plausible (a real place, contested), speculative (a minority reading or a later tradition), mythical (the poem places it outside the mappable world). Confidence is a published 0-12 rubric - textual, archaeological, scholarly and geographic, 0-3 each - and is an editorial judgement, not a probability.

locale.description: Language of the returned body. Default: en.

name: list_homeric_places
title: List Homeric Atlas places
